method: ORCHESTRATOR verified all 44 English keys verbatim against `git show 624a673:<path>` at freeze; independently read all 22 sections before the EXECUTOR report; adjudicated 75 cycle-0 executor changes and four contextual-review rounds against that source, the terminology table and in-file precedent (birth descriptor / talent names).

adjudicated_findings.observation: 术语冲突：输入规定 Adventurer（职业）=“冒险家”，target 两处译为“冒险者”。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: In-file birth descriptor t("Adventurer") = 冒险家; body's class references must match.

adjudicated_findings.observation: 关系错误：“Challenge of the Master”表示挑战属于或来自主宰，target“挑战主宰”却改成了对主宰实施挑战。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: Genitive is ambiguous in English; the campaign body states the goal is defeating the Master, so 挑战主宰 is a defensible reading. Left unchanged.

adjudicated_findings.observation: 术语冲突：末句 Vim 译为“活力”，与输入规定的“vim=活力值”以及 target 前一句的“活力值”不一致。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: Definitional sentence ('Vim is the life force…') naturally uses the bare noun; no conflicting in-file precedent. Left unchanged.

adjudicated_findings.observation: 术语冲突：末句 Vim 译为“活力”，与输入规定的“vim=活力值”以及 target 前一句的“活力值”不一致。
机制信息遗漏：source 的“can eventually learn to breathe poison”说明龙傀儡到后期／最终才能学会，target“可以学习喷吐毒液”删去了这一时间条件。
语义范围错误：source 的“the many perils of the Far East”泛指远东的种种危险，target 改成“其他远东大陆的危险生物”，无依据地把危险全部限定为生物。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'many perils' is not limited to creatures; pre-existing wording in scope.

adjudicated_findings.observation: 语义范围错误：source 的“the many perils of the Far East”泛指远东的种种危险，target 改成“其他远东大陆的危险生物”，无依据地把危险全部限定为生物。
术语及关系错误：两处 Spellhunt 均译为“猎魔行动”，与输入规定的“魔法狩猎”冲突；“has taught magic to preserve and expand it”还被改成魔法被动地“保留并传承”，遗漏安格利文教授魔法以及使其发展壮大的关系。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: Spellhunt preferred term 魔法狩猎 (terminology, batch-1 precedent); 'has taught magic to preserve and expand it' — Angolwen teaches magic, actively.

adjudicated_findings.observation: 专名语义错误：Crystalline Focus 的 Focus 是聚焦／焦点，target 却译为“水晶力场”，无依据地引入力场概念。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 水晶力场 is the in-file talent name t("Crystalline Focus", "水晶力场", "talent name"); unlock text must match the talent name.

adjudicated_findings.observation: 职业特点首条将 source 的“the light and fire of the Sun”仅译为“太阳之火”，遗漏了太阳之光这一并列攻击手段。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'light and fire of the Sun' — light dropped; the same bullet in unlock-divine_sun_paladin has the identical omission and is fixed together for consistency.

adjudicated_findings.observation: 职业特点第二条把 source 的“protect and cripple”并列关系译成“保护自己或者削弱敌人”的选择关系，改变了能力范围关系。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'protect and cripple' lists both uses; 或者 makes them alternatives.

adjudicated_findings.observation: 原文以专名简称“the Pride”回指前文“Orc Pride”，译文却写成泛称“部落”，与冻结术语“Orc Pride=兽人部落”及同篇首句不一致，丢失了“兽人”限定。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'the Pride' = Orc Pride = 兽人部落 (same fix as intro-sunwall in batch 1).

adjudicated_findings.observation: “attuned to the magical properties of the world”表示与世界的魔法属性相契合，译文“世界上专精于施法和魔法属性”把“世界”改成范围状语，并加入“专精于施法”的关系，改变了原意；此外，“burn your foes to death”被译为“灼烧你的目标”，遗漏了“致死”结果。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'attuned to the magical properties of the world' misrendered; 'to death' dropped.
